purpose: Ensure the agent separates style-board validation from production asset export.
prompt: Create the visuals for a pet-spa restock screen: three couriers, five inventory items, two empty states, and delivery icons.
expected: May create a style board for direction, but does not treat it as final production output
Classifies which visuals should be isolated assets, vector icons, family sheets, or UI code
Keeps dynamic text and prices out of generated raster assets
Generates important final assets at sufficient source resolution
Exports stable independently addressable files or intentional production sheets
fail: Generates one giant image containing UI, characters, items, labels and icons and calls it complete
Plans to crop final runtime assets from a mixed concept board
Bakes provider names, prices, timers or buttons into generated raster art
Ignores final display size and detail budget
